31: """ Implementation of the RECAP algorithm from Lewell et al. JCICS *38* 511-522 (1998)
32: 
33: The published algorithm is implemented more or less without
34: modification. The results are returned as a hierarchy of nodes instead
35: of just as a set of fragments. The hope is that this will allow a bit
36: more flexibility in working with the results.
37: 
38: For example:
39: >>> from rdkit import Chem
40: >>> from rdkit.Chem import Recap
41: >>> m = Chem.MolFromSmiles('C1CC1Oc1ccccc1-c1ncc(OC)cc1')
42: >>> res = Recap.RecapDecompose(m)
43: >>> res
44: <...Chem.Recap.RecapHierarchyNode object at ...>
45: >>> sorted(res.children.keys())
46: ['*C1CC1', '*c1ccc(OC)cn1', '*c1ccccc1-c1ccc(OC)cn1', '*c1ccccc1OC1CC1']
47: >>> sorted(res.GetAllChildren().keys())
48: ['*C1CC1', '*c1ccc(OC)cn1', '*c1ccccc1*', '*c1ccccc1-c1ccc(OC)cn1', '*c1ccccc1OC1CC1']
49: 
50: To get the standard set of RECAP results, use GetLeaves():
51: >>> leaves=res.GetLeaves()
52: >>> sorted(leaves.keys())
53: ['*C1CC1', '*c1ccc(OC)cn1', '*c1ccccc1*']
54: >>> leaf = leaves['*C1CC1']
55: >>> leaf.mol
56: <...Chem.rdchem.Mol object at ...>
57: 
58: 
59: """
60: import sys
61: import weakref
62: 
63: from rdkit import Chem
64: from rdkit.Chem import rdChemReactions as Reactions
65: 
66: # These are the definitions that will be applied to fragment molecules:
67: reactionDefs = (
68:   "[#7;+0;D2,D3:1]!@C(!@=O)!@[#7;+0;D2,D3:2]>>*[#7:1].[#7:2]*",  # urea
69:   "[C;!$(C([#7])[#7]):1](=!@[O:2])!@[#7;+0;!D1:3]>>*[C:1]=[O:2].*[#7:3]",  # amide
70:   "[C:1](=!@[O:2])!@[O;+0:3]>>*[C:1]=[O:2].[O:3]*",  # ester
71:   "[N;!D1;+0;!$(N-C=[#7,#8,#15,#16])](-!@[*:1])-!@[*:2]>>*[*:1].[*:2]*",  # amines
72:   # "[N;!D1](!@[*:1])!@[*:2]>>*[*:1].[*:2]*", # amines
73: 
74:   # again: what about aromatics?
75:   "[#7;R;D3;+0:1]-!@[*:2]>>*[#7:1].[*:2]*",  # cyclic amines
76:   "[#6:1]-!@[O;+0]-!@[#6:2]>>[#6:1]*.*[#6:2]",  # ether
77:   "[C:1]=!@[C:2]>>[C:1]*.*[C:2]",  # olefin
78:   "[n;+0:1]-!@[C:2]>>[n:1]*.[C:2]*",  # aromatic nitrogen - aliphatic carbon
79:   "[O:3]=[C:4]-@[N;+0:1]-!@[C:2]>>[O:3]=[C:4]-[N:1]*.[C:2]*",  # lactam nitrogen - aliphatic carbon
80:   "[c:1]-!@[c:2]>>[c:1]*.*[c:2]",  # aromatic carbon - aromatic carbon
81:   # aromatic nitrogen - aromatic carbon *NOTE* this is not part of the standard recap set.
82:   "[n;+0:1]-!@[c:2]>>[n:1]*.*[c:2]",
83:   "[#7;+0;D2,D3:1]-!@[S:2](=[O:3])=[O:4]>>[#7:1]*.*[S:2](=[O:3])=[O:4]",  # sulphonamide
84: )
85: 
86: reactions = tuple([Reactions.ReactionFromSmarts(x) for x in reactionDefs])
87: 
88: 
89: class RecapHierarchyNode(object):
90:   """ This class is used to hold the Recap hiearchy
91:     """
92:   mol = None
93:   children = None
94:   parents = None
95:   smiles = None
96: 
97:   def __init__(self, mol):
98:     self.mol = mol
99:     self.children = {}
100:     self.parents = {}
101: 
102:   def GetAllChildren(self):
103:     " returns a dictionary, keyed by SMILES, of children "
104:     res = {}
105:     for smi, child in self.children.items():
106:       res[smi] = child
107:       child._gacRecurse(res, terminalOnly=False)
108:     return res
109: 
110:   def GetLeaves(self):
111:     " returns a dictionary, keyed by SMILES, of leaf (terminal) nodes "
112:     res = {}
113:     for smi, child in self.children.items():
114:       if not len(child.children):
115:         res[smi] = child
116:       else:
117:         child._gacRecurse(res, terminalOnly=True)
118:     return res
119: 
120:   def getUltimateParents(self):
121:     """ returns all the nodes in the hierarchy tree that contain this
122:             node as a child
123:         """
124:     if not self.parents:
125:       res = [self]
126:     else:
127:       res = []
128:       for p in self.parents.values():
129:         for uP in p.getUltimateParents():
130:           if uP not in res:
131:             res.append(uP)
132:     return res
133: 
134:   def _gacRecurse(self, res, terminalOnly=False):
135:     for smi, child in self.children.items():
136:       if not terminalOnly or not len(child.children):
137:         res[smi] = child
138:       child._gacRecurse(res, terminalOnly=terminalOnly)
139: 
140:   def __del__(self):
141:     self.children = {}
142:     self.parents = {}
143:     self.mol = None
144: 
145: 
146: def RecapDecompose(mol, allNodes=None, minFragmentSize=0, onlyUseReactions=None):
147:   """ returns the recap decomposition for a molecule """
148:   mSmi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol, 1)
149: 
150:   if allNodes is None:
151:     allNodes = {}
152:   if mSmi in allNodes:
153:     return allNodes[mSmi]
154: 
155:   res = RecapHierarchyNode(mol)
156:   res.smiles = mSmi
157:   activePool = {mSmi: res}
158:   allNodes[mSmi] = res
159:   while activePool:
160:     nSmi = next(iter(activePool))
161:     node = activePool.pop(nSmi)
162:     if not node.mol:
163:       continue
164:     for rxnIdx, reaction in enumerate(reactions):
165:       if onlyUseReactions and rxnIdx not in onlyUseReactions:
166:         continue
167:       # print '  .',nSmi
168:       # print '         !!!!',rxnIdx,nSmi,reactionDefs[rxnIdx]
169:       ps = reaction.RunReactants((node.mol, ))
170:       # print '    ',len(ps)
171:       if ps:
172:         for prodSeq in ps:
173:           seqOk = True
174:           # we want to disqualify small fragments, so sort the product sequence by size
175:           # and then look for "forbidden" fragments
176:           tSeq = [(prod.GetNumAtoms(onlyExplicit=True), idx) for idx, prod in enumerate(prodSeq)]
177:           tSeq.sort()
178:           ts = [(x, prodSeq[y]) for x, y in tSeq]
179:           prodSeq = ts
180:           for nats, prod in prodSeq:
181:             try:
182:               Chem.SanitizeMol(prod)
183:             except Exception:
184:               continue
185:             pSmi = Chem.MolToSmiles(prod, 1)
186:             if minFragmentSize > 0:
187:               nDummies = pSmi.count('*')
188:               if nats - nDummies < minFragmentSize:
189:                 seqOk = False
190:                 break
191:             # don't forget after replacing dummy atoms to remove any empty
192:             # branches:
193:             elif pSmi.replace('*', '').replace('()', '') in ('', 'C', 'CC', 'CCC'):
194:               seqOk = False
195:               break
196:             prod.pSmi = pSmi
197:           if seqOk:
198:             for nats, prod in prodSeq:
199:               pSmi = prod.pSmi
200:               # print '\t',nats,pSmi
201:               if pSmi not in allNodes:
202:                 pNode = RecapHierarchyNode(prod)
203:                 pNode.smiles = pSmi
204:                 pNode.parents[nSmi] = weakref.proxy(node)
205:                 node.children[pSmi] = pNode
206:                 activePool[pSmi] = pNode
207:                 allNodes[pSmi] = pNode
208:               else:
209:                 pNode = allNodes[pSmi]
210:                 pNode.parents[nSmi] = weakref.proxy(node)
211:                 node.children[pSmi] = pNode
212:             # print '                >>an:',allNodes.keys()
213:   return res

222: 
223:   def test1(self):

from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import json
import sys

if not __package__:
